task_name: Unify Idempotency Key Generation Across OrderForm and Offline Queue

concerns_addressed: The shared key generator preserves key reuse for the same signature; tests now reset the memoized store before and after each case.
The signature-key store is bounded to 1000 entries and uses LRU promotion and eviction.
Offline enqueue persistence is directly tested by asserting the stored payload retains idempotency_key after enqueue and list.
randomUUID-unavailable environments use crypto.getRandomValues to produce UUID v4 keys when available; queue IDs use the same secure fallback.

strengths: The idempotency signature store is bounded and tested for both eviction and LRU promotion.
The enqueue-to-list round trip directly verifies persistence of payload.idempotency_key.
Fallback UUID generation uses crypto.getRandomValues when randomUUID is unavailable, and tests verify UUID v4 shape.
Queue replay uses the stored payload key, with a stable queue-ID fallback for legacy entries.
All three exact T1 validation commands passed.
